nodes.name: .env.development
nodes.summary: Vite development-environment variables for the admin app, enabling route permission checks and serving at the root public base path.
nodes.languageNotes: Vite loads MODE plus VITE_-prefixed public env vars; VITE_ENABLE_ROUTE_PERMISSION and VITE_BASE_PATH are injected at build/dev time.

nodes.name: .env.production
nodes.summary: Vite production-environment variables for the admin app, enabling route permission checks and setting the public base path to /gritty-lots/.
nodes.languageNotes: Same VITE_ keys as the development env file, with VITE_BASE_PATH=/gritty-lots/ for deployed asset URLs.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Admin SPA HTML shell that mounts #app, loads src/main.ts as a module, and applies a stored color-mode class before first paint to avoid FOUC.
nodes.languageNotes: Inline IIFE reads localStorage key gritty-color-mode (light/dark/system) and prefers-color-scheme, then toggles the html.dark class.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Private ESM workspace package for the Vue 3 admin app, defining Vite scripts and depending on workspace packages auto-route, data-schema, page-neural, and ui.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript config for admin app sources with @/* path aliases, Vite and PWA client types, and Vue DOM tsconfig inheritance.
nodes.languageNotes: Maps @/* to ./src/*; enables experimentalDecorators while keeping useDefineForClassFields false.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Solution-style TypeScript project that references the app and Node/Vite configs without compiling any files itself.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript config for the admin Vite config file using NodeNext modules, noEmit, and the repo root tsconfig.
nodes.languageNotes: module nodenext with allowImportingTsExtensions and verbatimModuleSyntax for vite.config.ts.
